Peptides in Paradise, NV

D2C Peptides ships research peptides and lab supplies to Paradise, the unincorporated town of about 191,000 people that holds the Las Vegas Valley's official weather station, from the USA and Canada.123 This page covers what the area's hot nights mean for a delivered parcel.

Keeping peptides cool in Paradise

Paradise holds the valley's official climate station. It sits at Harry Reid International Airport, near the southern end of the Las Vegas Strip, and its coordinates fall inside the Paradise census-designated place,23 so the valley's official readings are taken here. July averages a high of 104.5 °F and a low of 82.0 °F,9 and 78.2 days a year reach 100 °F or more.10

Nights give a parcel little relief. The National Weather Service describes an urban heat island at the center of the valley, especially near downtown and along the Strip, and says the airport often records lows 5 to 15 degrees warmer than outlying areas.2 The warmest low on record there is 95 °F, reached on July 19, 2005, and again on July 1, 2013, and the all-time high is 120 °F, set on July 7, 2024.11

Product labels show why no single heat rule covers every vial. Among FDA-approved freeze-dried products, tesamorelin vials (EGRIFTA SV and EGRIFTA WR) are stored at room temperature, 20 to 25 °C, somatropin vials (ZOMACTON) in a refrigerator at 2 to 8 °C, and one chorionic gonadotropin product from Fresenius Kabi at 20 to 25 °C.12131415 The EGRIFTA SV label permits excursions from 15 to 30 °C (59 to 86 °F), a limit for that one product, not a rule for other peptides.12 Bachem, a peptide manufacturer, marks each label with the recommended long-term storage condition.7 Once a Paradise parcel is indoors, that label condition is the one to follow, and the storage guide goes into more detail.

About Paradise

Paradise has no city government; it is one of Clark County's unincorporated towns.1 The 2020 Census counted 191,238 people in the Paradise census-designated place.16 Nevada's certified estimate for the town is 191,215 on July 1, 2025, and the county's own August 2025 estimate is 192,531.117 The Census figures describe the Paradise census-designated place, while the state and county estimates cover the town. The census-designated place covers 42.404 square miles of land and no water,18 and the ground at its internal point sits about 2,039 feet above sea level.1918

Work here leans toward hospitality: 28.1 percent of employed residents work in arts, entertainment, recreation, accommodation and food services, against 20.3 percent in the City of Las Vegas (ACS 2020 to 2024).2021 Most households rent, with 58.1 percent of occupied homes renter-occupied.22 The median age is 39.3 years and 36.8 percent of residents are Hispanic or Latino,23 while 38.4 percent of residents age 5 and older speak a language other than English at home and 26.4 percent speak Spanish.24

Frequently asked questions

Is Paradise part of the City of Las Vegas?

No. Paradise is an unincorporated town of Clark County, listed by the state among the county's towns rather than its cities, so it has no city council.1 Towns like it have a Town Advisory Board instead: Enterprise's, for example, was created by the County Commission to give input on town matters,4 and Paradise's board meets at the Paradise Park Community Center.5 None of this changes an order: a Paradise address ships on the same terms as any other in the valley, and the Las Vegas hub links every Clark County page.

Which ZIP codes are in Paradise?

Six ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, the Census Bureau's stand-ins for USPS ZIP codes, lie mostly inside Paradise: 89119, 89120, 89121, 89123, 89158 and 89169. Three more, 89103, 89109 and 89118, are partly inside, and 14 in all touch the boundary, some only at the edges.6 Orders to any of them ship from the USA and Canada, and the shipping page holds the policy.

Is a peptide ruined if the parcel sat in the heat?

It depends on the peptide, and neither maker cited here gives one heat limit for every peptide. Bachem typically ships freeze-dried peptides at room temperature,7 and GenScript notes that peptides keep far longer as dry powder than in solution, with stability that depends on each sequence.8 Once the parcel is inside, store the vials as their label directs, and use the returns page to report a parcel that arrives damaged.
